answer: In the Opal Lagoon registry, an agent creator must permanently burn 8 Nectar tokens and solve a verifiable delay function requiring 10^12 sequential SHA-256 hashes per public key, verified via a STARK proof on-chain. Because each key requires a unique salt, costs scale linearly: N fake identities cause an irreversible loss of 8N Nectar tokens and N×10^12 hashes, preventing cheap resets.
